_comment: Per-sound-file gain overrides, applied to every sound regardless of category. gain is a linear multiplier: 0 mutes the sound outright (it is dropped before taking a voice), 1 leaves it untouched, 0.25 makes it a quarter as loud. Use this for individual samples that are correct in isolation but grate through repetition. Edit and restart to apply.

35820.note: Mesmer generic cast-start layer. Present in 143 of 527 skills at ms 6-8, so it retriggers on nearly every Mesmer cast and drones.

55261.note: Monk protection generic cast-start layer. Present in 20 skills (Aegis, Guardian, Protective Spirit, Mend/Restore) at ms 0-8.
